fields.name: Postgres Type Mapping
fields.responsibility: Covers the PostgreSQL type system property by property: for each PostgreSQL data type it declares how a model property becomes an input or output parameter of that type, how a parameter or result column of that type is read back into the property, what the property's .NET type is allowed to be, and what column definition the type requires when a table is created for bulk loading. It also offers the same per-type parameter construction directly to callers building a parameter set by hand, including the array and hstore accessors that have no cross-platform equivalent.
